command: set +e; SHELLY_URL=http://192.168.0.16 XIAOMI_MAC=A4:C1:38:4F:24:CD TP357_MAC=F7:5F:8D:0F:76:20 SENSOR_FILTER=all VPD_OPTIONS=both pnpm hardware:shelly:matrix; MATRIX_RC=$?; BASE=http://192.168.0.16; curl -fsS --max-time 8 "$BASE/rpc/Switch.Set?id=0&on=false" -o /tmp/lcl-final-off-v2.json; OFF_RC=$?; curl -fsS --max-time 8 "$BASE/rpc/Switch.GetStatus?id=0" -o /tmp/lcl-final-switch-v2.json; STATUS_RC=$?; curl -fsS --max-time 8 "$BASE/rpc/Script.List" -o /tmp/lcl-final-scripts-v2.json; SCRIPTS_RC=$?; if [ $OFF_RC -ne 0 ] || [ $STATUS_RC -ne 0 ] || [ $SCRIPTS_RC -ne 0 ]; then echo 'final Shelly cleanup RPC failed' >&2; exit 1; fi; python3 -c 'import json; from pathlib import Path; sw=json.loads(Path("/tmp/lcl-final-switch-v2.json").read_text()); ss=json.loads(Path("/tmp/lcl-final-scripts-v2.json").read_text()); assert sw.get("output") is False, sw; scripts=ss.get("scripts",[]) if isinstance(ss,dict) else ss; managed=[s for s in scripts if s.get("name")=="Local Climate Link Thermostat"]; assert all(s.get("running") is not True for s in managed), managed; print("FINAL_RELAY_OFF=true"); print("FINAL_MANAGED_RUNNING=0"); print("FINAL_MANAGED_SCRIPT_COUNT="+str(len(managed)))'; CLEAN_RC=$?; if [ $CLEAN_RC -ne 0 ]; then exit $CLEAN_RC; fi; exit $MATRIX_RC
